annotations.title: Generate GovCon RMF, Continuous ATO (cATO), SSP & POA&M Package

description: Transform RFP cybersecurity clauses, system architecture descriptions, and cloud hosting baselines into a NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 / DoDI 8510.01 RMF / FedRAMP / StateRAMP Authority to Operate (ATO & Continuous ATO) package with FIPS 199 / CNSSI 1253 security categorization, System Security Plan (SSP) control inheritance matrices, eMASS/CSAM-ready Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) schedules, Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) DevSecOps blueprints, and Shipley proposal narratives. This is a read-only, stateless generative authorization modeling call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `system_architecture_and_rfp_cyber_text` accepts 40 to 100,000 characters, `cloud_hosting_and_inherited_controls_context` accepts 20 to 80,000 characters, and `target_authorization_framework` and `target_impact_level` calibrate control baselines across DoD RMF IL2-IL6, FedRAMP, StateRAMP, and CMMC 2.0). Use this tool when building System Security Plans (SSPs), eMASS POA&M items, FIPS 199 categorizations, or cATO roadmaps for an ATO boundary; use `answer_security_questionnaire` instead to answer vendor security questionnaires and calculate a numeric DoD SPRS score (-203 to 110), or `scan_far_dfars_clauses` to audit FAR/DFARS solicitation clauses.

rfp_security_and_ato_requirements.description: Raw text from RFP Section C/H/L/M detailing ATO, RMF (eMASS/Xacta), FedRAMP, StateRAMP, DISA Impact Level (IL4/IL5), NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, or CMMC Level 2 authorization requirements.

system_architecture_and_boundary_context.description: Description of the bidder's cloud environment, hosting boundary, identity provider, encryption posture, DevSecOps toolchain, and any existing compliance gaps.

target_ato_timeline_days.description: Target calendar days from contract award to achieve full ATO / cATO authorization.

name: generate_ato_rmf_package

ato_readiness_score.description: Overall ATO / cATO readiness score from 0 to 100 based on boundary maturity, control coverage, and open findings.

authorization_boundary_summary.description: FIPS 199 categorization, Impact Level baseline, GRC system of record, CSP control inheritance percentage, and boundary summary.

cato_devsecops_pipeline_blueprint.description: Continuous ATO (cATO) DevSecOps CI/CD security gates, ConMon cadence, and OSCAL/SBOM automation blueprint.

poam_remediation_schedule.description: Structured Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) remediation table for any open findings or architecture gaps.

proposal_technical_volume_ato_narrative.description: Executive-ready Shipley Technical Volume narrative explaining how the Offeror will achieve rapid, low-risk ATO / cATO without delaying mission deployment.

rmf_six_step_milestone_plan.description: Day-by-day RMF Step 1 through Step 6 schedule to achieve IATT and full ATO within target_ato_timeline_days.

ssp_control_implementations.description: Audit-ready NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 / NIST 800-171 System Security Plan (SSP) control implementation narratives.

title: Generate GovCon RMF, Continuous ATO (cATO), SSP & POA&M Package
